newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Egypt's Mubarak in Libya for trade talks.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak in Libya for trade talks.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak arrived in Libya on Thursday and went into talks with Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi, Libyan radio said.
Egyptian sources said Mubarak's two-day talks would focus on trade cooperation between the two North African neighbours.
The radio said Mubarak arrived in the Libyan coastal northeastern city of Tobruk where he was met by Gaddafi.
Airport sources in Egypt earlier said Mubarak would fly to the Libyan border and take a car across because a U.N. embargo bans flights in or out of Libya.
The United Nations imposed sanctions against Tripoli for its refusal to hand over two Libyans suspected of involvement in the bombing of a Pan Am airliner over Scotland in 1988.
Mubarak said last month the United Nations should review those sanctions because they had gone on for too long and risked becoming meaningless.

Egyptian government sources said Mubarak would attend meetings of the joint Egyptian-Libyan committee which would discuss setting up a free trade zone between the two countries and other trade projects.
